messages.subject: [R-sig-ME] GAMS in R course
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,
If you are interested in Generalised Additive Models in R,  we have just 2 seats left for our upcoming course in December (7–10 December).
 
If you’re interested, please check out the course details here:
[ https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/gams-in-r/ ]( https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/gams-in-r/ ) 
 
Feel free to share this with anyone who might be interested!
Best,
 
Carlo
